messages:
fiona: Heads-up: prod ap-northeast1 embeddings are returning truncated vectors for long inputs after the last opt-quant rollout. Root cause: quantization path dropped trailing whitespace for >1024 tokens which causes downstream encoder mismatch. I have a rebuild that restores the length-check and preserves quantized path. Need expedited push: staging smoke then prod within 15m. Prefer single-canary skip to save time. @raj @oliver please ack.
deploy-bot: Policy check: service=embeds requires canary. Override allowed with 2 ENG + 1 SRE approvals.
raj: Can you confirm rollback plan and that there are no DB/config changes?
fiona: No DB or secret changes. Rollback: `kubectl set image deployment/embeds redwood/embed=redwood/embed:v3.1.0-opt` (current). Hotfix image: redwood/embed:v3.1.1-quantfix-319000. Patch is deterministic length-check + extra unit test.
oliver: I'll run targeted end-to-end smoke exercising long-input paths and the downstream encoder. smoke script: `./ops/smoke_long_inputs.sh --region ap-northeast1` TTL ~3m.
keith: I'll prep infra monitoring and set alert: ap-northeast1 vector-mismatch error-rate > 0.5% => auto-rollback.
oncall-sre: Auto-rollback thresholds noted. I'll standby and run synthetic long-input probes.
oliver: staging smoke started.
oliver: staging smoke PASS. exercised 1024+ token batches, kv warmed, no errors in 4m.
raj: +1 after smoke. good to go.
fiona: Requesting expedite + pin. Command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v3.1.1-quantfix-319000 --target staging --pin --override-canary --notes "hotfix: restore length-check in quant path to prevent truncated vectors"```
deploy-bot: Override flag detected. Approval log: fiona/raj/oliver. Scheduling staging deploy.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded in 52s. sha=deadc0de. healthcheck=smoke-sigs, timeout=3m.
keith: Rolling to prod with quick rollout: 5% (2m) -> 25% (3m) -> 100% (5m). If vector-mismatch errors increase >0.5% for 2m, rollback automatically.
fiona: Rolling now. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v3.1.1-quantfix-319000 --target prod --pin --rollout 100% --notes "expedite: quant path length-check hotfix"```
deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Auto-rollback on ap-northeast1 vector-mismatch > 0.5% sustained for 2m.
oncall-sre: Synthetic probes show no regressions at 5% and 25% steps. Monitoring live dashboard: https://dash.internal/embeds/mismatch/319000
release-czar: Quick note: I'll need a one-line release blurb to publish in the midnight change window. Please paste it here before finalizing.
fiona: Draft release blurb: "embeds: fix truncated vectors for long inputs caused by quantization path; no schema changes."
deploy-bot: Prod rollout completed to 100%. No rollback triggered.
fiona: Thanks team. Publishing release note and changelog now: https://docs.internal/releases/319000-quantfix. Keeping a 45m watch; if anything odd pings oncall DM me.
keith: Alerts muted for noise, will escalate on signal. Closing thread after watch window."
